editorial.blurb: Kayao seamlessly blends Peruvian traditions with Asian influences, delivering impeccably executed dishes in a warm, sophisticated setting where every detail—from tableside guacamole to expertly crafted pisco sours—feels like an occasion.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive during Happy Hour to sample multiple dishes without breaking the bank, and request a seat where you can watch the bartender Miguel craft pisco sours—they're genuinely the best in the city.
